class.name: OcgV3dViewer
class.brief_description: Defines services on Viewer type objects. The methods of this class allow editing and interrogation of the parameters linked to the viewer its friend classes (View,light,plane).
class.description: ! Defines services on Viewer type objects. ! The methods of this class allow editing and ! interrogation of the parameters linked to the viewer ! its friend classes (View,light,plane).

method.name: V3d_Viewer
method.description: Create a Viewer with the given graphic driver and with default parameters: - View orientation: V3d_XposYnegZpos - View background: Quantity_NOC_GRAY30 - Shading model: V3d_GOURAUD

method.name: IfMoreViews
method.description: Returns True if One View more can be defined in this Viewer.

method.name: CreateView
method.description: Creates a view in the viewer according to its default parameters.

method.name: SetViewOn_1
method.description: Activates all of the views of a viewer attached to a window.

method.name: SetViewOn_2
method.description: Activates a particular view in the Viewer. Must be call if the Window attached to the view has been Deiconified.

method.name: SetViewOff_1
method.description: Deactivates all the views of a Viewer attached to a window.

method.name: SetViewOff_2
method.description: Deactivates a particular view in the Viewer. Must be call if the Window attached to the view has been Iconified .

method.name: Update
method.description: Deprecated, Redraw() should be used instead.

method.name: Redraw
method.description: Redraws all the views of the Viewer even if no modification has taken place. Must be called if all the views of the Viewer are exposed, as for example in a global DeIconification.

method.name: RedrawImmediate
method.description: Updates layer of immediate presentations.

method.name: Invalidate
method.description: Invalidates viewer content but does not redraw it.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Suppresses the Viewer.

method.name: Driver
method.description: Return Graphic Driver instance.

method.name: StructureManager
method.description: Returns the structure manager associated to this viewer.

method.name: DefaultRenderingParams
method.description: Return default Rendering Parameters. By default these parameters are set in a new V3d_View.

method.name: SetDefaultRenderingParams
method.description: Set default Rendering Parameters.

method.name: SetDefaultBackgroundColor
method.description: Defines the default background colour of views attached to the viewer by supplying the color object

method.name: GetGradientBackground
method.description: Returns the gradient background of the view.

method.name: SetDefaultBgGradientColors
method.description: Defines the default gradient background colours of views attached to the viewer by supplying the colour objects

method.name: DefaultViewSize
method.description: Returns the default size of the view.

method.name: SetDefaultViewSize
method.description: Gives a default size for the creation of views of the viewer.

method.name: DefaultViewProj
method.description: Returns the default Projection.

method.name: SetDefaultViewProj
method.description: Sets the default projection for creating views in the viewer.

method.name: DefaultVisualization
method.description: Returns the default type of Visualization.

method.name: SetDefaultVisualization
method.description: Gives the default visualization mode.

method.name: DefaultShadingModel
method.description: Returns the default type of Shading; Graphic3d_TypeOfShadingModel_Phong by default.

method.name: SetDefaultShadingModel
method.description: Gives the default type of SHADING.

method.name: DefaultTypeOfView
method.description: Returns the default type of View (orthographic or perspective projection) to be returned by CreateView() method.

method.name: SetDefaultTypeOfView
method.description: Set the default type of View (orthographic or perspective projection) to be returned by CreateView() method.

method.name: DefaultBackgroundColor
method.description: Returns the default background colour object.

method.name: DefaultBgGradientColors
method.description: Returns the gradient background colour objects of the view.

method.name: GetAllZLayers
method.description: Return all Z layer ids in sequence ordered by overlay level from lowest layer to highest ( foreground ). The first layer ID in sequence is the default layer that can't be removed.

method.name: RemoveZLayer
method.description: Remove Z layer with ID <theLayerId>. Method returns Standard_False if the layer can not be removed or doesn't exists. By default, there are always default bottom-level layer that can't be removed.

method.name: ZLayerSettings
method.description: Returns the settings of a single Z layer.

method.name: SetZLayerSettings
method.description: Sets the settings for a single Z layer.

method.name: ActiveViewIterator
method.description: Return an iterator for active views.

method.name: LastActiveView
method.description: returns true if there is only one active view.

method.name: DefinedViewIterator
method.description: Return an iterator for defined views.

method.name: SetDefaultLights
method.description: Defines default lights: positional-light 0.3 0. 0. directional-light V3d_XnegYposZpos directional-light V3d_XnegYneg ambient-light

method.name: SetLightOn_2
method.description: Activates MyLight in the viewer.

method.name: SetLightOn_1
method.description: Activates all the lights defined in this viewer.

method.name: SetLightOff_2
method.description: Deactivates MyLight in this viewer.

method.name: SetLightOff_1
method.description: Deactivate all the Lights defined in this viewer.

method.name: AddLight
method.description: Adds Light in Sequence Of Lights.

method.name: DelLight
method.description: Delete Light in Sequence Of Lights.

method.name: UpdateLights
method.description: Updates the lights of all the views of a viewer.

method.name: ActiveLights
method.description: Return a list of active lights.

method.name: ActiveLightIterator
method.description: Return an iterator for defined lights.

method.name: DefinedLights
method.description: Return a list of defined lights.

method.name: DefinedLightIterator
method.description: Return an iterator for defined lights.

method.name: Erase
method.description: Erase all Objects in All the views.

method.name: UnHighlight
method.description: UnHighlight all Objects in All the views.

method.name: ComputedMode
method.description: returns true if the computed mode can be used.

method.name: SetComputedMode
method.description: Set if the computed mode can be used.

method.name: DefaultComputedMode
method.description: returns true if by default the computed mode must be used.

method.name: SetDefaultComputedMode
method.description: Set if by default the computed mode must be used.

method.name: PrivilegedPlane
method.description: ! @name privileged plane management

method.name: ActivateGrid
method.description: Activates the grid in all views of <me>.

method.name: DeactivateGrid
method.description: Deactivates the grid in all views of <me>.

method.name: SetGridEcho_1
method.description: Show/Don't show grid echo to the hit point. If TRUE,the grid echo will be shown at ConvertToGrid() time.

method.name: SetGridEcho_2
method.description: Show grid echo <aMarker> to the hit point. Warning: When the grid echo marker is not set, a default marker is build with the attributes: marker type : Aspect_TOM_STAR marker color : Quantity_NOC_GRAY90 marker size : 3.0

method.name: GridEcho
method.description: Returns TRUE when grid echo must be displayed at hit point.

method.name: IsGridActive
method.description: Returns Standard_True if a grid is activated in <me>.

method.name: Grid_1
method.description: Returns the defined grid in <me>.

method.name: Grid_2
method.description: Returns the defined grid in <me>.

method.name: GridType
method.description: Returns the current grid type defined in <me>.

method.name: GridDrawMode
method.description: Returns the current grid draw mode defined in <me>.

method.name: RectangularGridValues
method.description: Returns the definition of the rectangular grid.

method.name: SetRectangularGridValues
method.description: Sets the definition of the rectangular grid. <XOrigin>, <YOrigin> defines the origin of the grid. <XStep> defines the interval between 2 vertical lines. <YStep> defines the interval between 2 horizontal lines. <RotationAngle> defines the rotation angle of the grid.

method.name: CircularGridValues
method.description: Returns the definition of the circular grid.

method.name: SetCircularGridValues
method.description: Sets the definition of the circular grid. <XOrigin>, <YOrigin> defines the origin of the grid. <RadiusStep> defines the interval between 2 circles. <DivisionNumber> defines the section number of one half circle. <RotationAngle> defines the rotation angle of the grid.

method.name: CircularGridGraphicValues
method.description: Returns the location and the size of the grid.

method.name: SetCircularGridGraphicValues
method.description: Sets the location and the size of the grid. <XSize> defines the width of the grid. <YSize> defines the height of the grid. <OffSet> defines the displacement along the plane normal.

method.name: RectangularGridGraphicValues
method.description: Returns the location and the size of the grid.

method.name: SetRectangularGridGraphicValues
method.description: Sets the location and the size of the grid. <XSize> defines the width of the grid. <YSize> defines the height of the grid. <OffSet> defines the displacement along the plane normal.

method.name: ShowGridEcho
method.description: Display grid echo at requested point in the view.

method.name: HideGridEcho
method.description: Temporarily hide grid echo.

method.name: IsActive
method.description: Returns Standard_True if a grid is activated in <me>.

method.name: InitActiveViews
method.description: Initializes an internal iterator on the active views.

method.name: MoreActiveViews
method.description: Returns true if there are more active view(s) to return.

method.name: NextActiveViews
method.description: Go to the next active view (if there is not, ActiveView will raise an exception)

method.name: InitDefinedViews
method.description: Initializes an internal iterator on the Defined views.

method.name: MoreDefinedViews
method.description: returns true if there are more Defined view(s) to return.

method.name: NextDefinedViews
method.description: Go to the next Defined view (if there is not, DefinedView will raise an exception)

method.name: InitActiveLights
method.description: Initializes an internal iteratator on the active Lights.

method.name: MoreActiveLights
method.description: returns true if there are more active Light(s) to return.

method.name: NextActiveLights
method.description: Go to the next active Light (if there is not, ActiveLight() will raise an exception)

method.name: InitDefinedLights
method.description: Initializes an internal iterattor on the Defined Lights.

method.name: MoreDefinedLights
method.description: Returns true if there are more Defined Light(s) to return.

method.name: NextDefinedLights
method.description: Go to the next Defined Light (if there is not, DefinedLight() will raise an exception)

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
